eqproxy_help: ExyonQ Proxy (EQProxy): reverse proxy and load balancer
disclosure.plan: BENCHMARK_PLAN.md §2 disclosure, §3 scenarios, §4 metrics, §5 bias controls
disclosure.topology: one Linux host; origin + EQProxy/HAProxy/Envoy + oha share it; proxies on a Docker bridge, oha on host loopback ports

scenario_interpretation.S-H1-03: HTTP/1.1 new connection per request, 1 KiB payload

generator.warmup: one discarded run per product and scenario (5s, except S-H1-03=2s)

configs.s-h1-eqproxy.toml:
schema_version = 1
shutdown_grace = "5s"

[listener.web]
listen = "0.0.0.0:19601"
mode = "http"
backend = "api"
maxconn = 4096

[backend.api]
server = "172.22.0.2:19002"
configs.s-h1-haproxy.cfg:
global
  log stdout format raw local0
  maxconn 4096
  nbthread 2
defaults
  log global
  mode http
  option httplog
  option http-keep-alive
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 60s
  timeout server 60s
  timeout http-request 5s
frontend web
  bind *:19611
  default_backend api
backend api
  server s1 172.22.0.2:19002 maxconn 4096
configs.s-h1-envoy.yaml:
static_resources:
  listeners:
  - name: listener_0
    address:
      socket_address:
        address: 0.0.0.0
        port_value: 19641
    filter_chains:
    - filters:
      - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
        typed_config:
          "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager
          stat_prefix: ingress_http
          codec_type: AUTO
          route_config:
            name: local_route
            virtual_hosts:
            - name: local_service
              domains: ["*"]
              routes:
              - match:
                  prefix: "/"
                route:
                  cluster: origin
                  timeout: 60s
          http_filters:
          - name: envoy.filters.http.router
            typed_config:
              "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.router.v3.Router
  clusters:
  - name: origin
    connect_timeout: 5s
    type: STATIC
    lb_policy: ROUND_ROBIN
    load_assignment:
      cluster_name: origin
      endpoints:
      - lb_endpoints:
        - endpoint:
            address:
              socket_address:
                address: 172.22.0.2
                port_value: 19002
admin:
  address:
    socket_address:
      address: 127.0.0.1
      port_value: 9901

limitations: Only 3 of 18 BENCHMARK_PLAN scenarios were executed; the operator study and the other scenarios remain NOT EXECUTED.
One Linux host; origin, all three proxies and generator share it; no CPU affinity or separate machines.
Closed-loop oha; percentiles are not coordinated-omission corrected; full raw histograms are published.
Envoy is a static bootstrap (not Istio and not xDS); no control plane is measured.
No TLS, h2/h3, rules, rewrites, compression, health checks or plugins in this slice.
The EQProxy image is built from the working tree, not a published release artifact.
A scenario whose direct sink is below 1.20x the fastest proxy is Not comparable, even if every response was HTTP 200.
A measured run below 50% of its scenario median marks the series unstable; it is retained in raw data.
